C1392.title: Mirai Co-Author Paras Jha Sentenced to Home Confinement and $8.6 Million Restitution
C1392.summary: In October 2018, a federal court in New Jersey sentenced Paras Jha for a series of DDoS attacks against Rutgers University. Jha received six months of home confinement, five years of supervised release, and 2,500 hours of community service, and was ordered to pay the university $8.6 million in restitution. The Justice Department also identified him as a co-author of the Mirai botnet malware.
